description: The app bar of a website or a desktop app (DESIGN.md, TopBar): glass, at least TsuyaSize.bar tall, TsuyaRadius.md, floating TsuyaSpace.s12 from the top and sides, TsuyaShadows.md. start (a brand or a back button), links, center (a search field) and end (icon buttons). Below TsuyaBreakpoint.tablet the links move into a menu opened from a plain icon button at the end, named by the `more` label. Too wide for the room (a large text scale), the links and center scroll sideways. When start and end do not fit side by side, the bar grows rows instead: start, end, then the links and center.

constructors.description: A bar with start, links, center and end.

params.name: start
params.description: A brand or a back button, at the start.

params.name: links
params.description: Navigation links, centred; below TsuyaBreakpoint.tablet, in a menu at the end instead.

params.name: center
params.description: A search field, centred alongside links.
